title: Batch update the same group of status labels
goal: Use querySelectorAll to select multiple elements and update them one by one.
summary: Two of the three stations are ready. When the button is clicked, the two labels to be updated will display "checked" together.
tasks: After clicking #mark, change the text of the .pending label to "checked".
does not change tags without .pending class.

example.note: querySelectorAll returns all matching items, which can be traversed using for…of or forEach.

hint: querySelector has only the first result. Use querySelectorAll to get the entire set of tags to update.
